results.understood_as: List the regions whose revenue in Q4 2025 was lower than in Q3 2025.
results.sql:
WITH regional_quarterly_rev AS (
  SELECT
    c.region,
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
            1 - oi.discount
          )
          ELSE 0
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS q3_2025_revenue,
    ROUND(
      SUM(
        CASE
          WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
            1 - oi.discount
          )
          ELSE 0
        END
      ),
      2
    ) AS q4_2025_revenue
  FROM customers AS c
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE
    o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    c.region
)
SELECT
  region,
  q3_2025_revenue,
  q4_2025_revenue
FROM regional_quarterly_rev
WHERE
  q4_2025_revenue < q3_2025_revenue
ORDER BY
  region
LIMIT 500

results.understood_as: What was the gross margin by product category in 2025?
results.sql:
SELECT
  p.category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
    1 - oi.discount
  )), 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS cost,
  ROUND(
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
      1 - oi.discount
    )) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost),
    2
  ) AS gross_profit,
  ROUND(
    (
      SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
        1 - oi.discount
      )) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost)
    ) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
      1 - oi.discount
    )),
    4
  ) AS gross_margin
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025'
GROUP BY
  p.category
ORDER BY
  gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 500

results.understood_as: By what percentage did October-November revenue grow in 2025 compared with October-November 2024?
results.sql:
WITH period_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date) AS yr,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
      1 - oi.discount
    )) AS revenue
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE
    o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    AND (
      (
        o.order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-11-30'
      )
      OR (
        o.order_date >= '2025-10-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-11-30'
      )
    )
  GROUP BY
    yr
)
SELECT
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2024' THEN revenue END), 2) AS revenue_oct_nov_2024,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2025' THEN revenue END), 2) AS revenue_oct_nov_2025,
  ROUND(
    (
      MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2025' THEN revenue END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2024' THEN revenue END)
    ) * 100.0 / MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2024' THEN revenue END),
    2
  ) AS percentage_growth
FROM period_revenue
LIMIT 500
